snippet.title: UMVC3 Community Edition Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The new age of Marvel vs. Capcom 3 is here! Community Edition is an upcoming mod which utilizes Clone Engine (Made by Gneiss) to add tons of invisible character slots below the base roster! It'll contain over 50 brand new characters made by a variety of different modders coming together! Please support Capcom and buy Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3, and the rest of their amazing games, through Steam!  

Special Thanks:
Thanks to Angelglory for providing narration! (Sorry for missing your narration credit on the last page my friend! Been in the editing mines all day!)
Thanks to Tabs, Calikingz01, Heefnoff, and Treewiz for providing Hyper Combo footage.
Thanks to MooCartoons for the myriad of modded costumes.
Thanks to Xeno for the X Dante Trigger costume.
Thanks to Danteonwifi for the DMC4 Dante costume.
Thanks to Treewiz, Chimichangar, Angelglory, Watcherkave, Xeno, Voltaic, Novembermann, and Calikingz01 for showing off your new projects.
Thanks to Heefnoff for editing.
